description: Object encryption: plain = u32_be(len(json)) || json || zero padding (256 B buckets below 16 KiB, 4 KiB from 16 KiB); ct = XChaCha20-Poly1305(DEK, nonce, plain, object_aad(vault, object, revision, format=1)); wrapped_dek = XChaCha20-Poly1305(KEK_class, wrapped_dek_nonce, DEK, wrapped_dek_aad(vault, object, revision)). Inputs carry the exact JSON bytes.
